description: Serve many stdio MCP servers from one container, for ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP clients
name: io.github.ni-c/mcp-hub

environmentVariables.description: Path to the mcp.json listing the servers to expose, in Claude Code's mcpServers format (default mcp.json in the working directory)
environmentVariables.name: CONFIG_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Minutes of inactivity before a server is put to sleep; 0 starts every server at launch and keeps it running (default 60)
environmentVariables.name: IDLE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES

environmentVariables.description: Tool snapshots of sleeping servers (default .mcp-hub/tool-cache.json beside the config)
environmentVariables.name: TOOL_CACHE_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Mirror the hub's log lines into this file; stdout carries the protocol, so logging goes to stderr otherwise
environmentVariables.name: LOG_FILE

title: mcp-hub
